description: AI-generated photographic-style neutral pearl-white studio background plate for the blog editor showcase. This image is not a photograph of a real physical studio.

generation.exactPrompt:
Use case: product-mockup
Asset type: a standalone static website background plate for a premium editor canvas stage; real DOM interface will be placed over the center later. Generate ONLY the empty physical background, no interface.
Primary request: photorealistic high-end product photography studio backdrop, landscape 3:2 composition, pearl white, warm white and extremely pale neutral silver gray.
Scene/backdrop: a seamless pale white architectural light table or photographic cyclorama with subtle, believable material depth. One very thin translucent curved frosted-glass edge enters only at the lower-left outer corner; a second delicate curved white paper or frosted-glass edge enters only at the upper-right outer corner. These are peripheral framing details, not objects in the center.
Composition/framing: landscape wide view, clean slightly elevated studio camera looking toward a broad almost-flat seamless pale plane. Central 65 percent of the entire picture must stay completely empty, very pale near-white and visually quiet, reserved for a large rectangular real interface overlay. All visible material edges stay within the outer 15 percent margins or extreme corners. No horizon line cutting across the center. No central pedestal or platform object.
Lighting/mood: beautifully controlled soft side light, nuanced soft contact shadows around the peripheral materials, a tiny physically plausible trace of refraction near frosted-glass edges. Restrained, tactile and calm editorial product photography. Matte plaster or fine paper surface with extremely subtle realistic microtexture; very low contrast in the center.
Color palette: neutral pearl white, warm white, pale silver gray only. White balanced lighting, no blue, purple or black.
Constraints: Empty photographic background plate ONLY. No screen, no interface, no browser window, no phone, no laptop, no electronic device, no text, no letters, no logo, no icon, no watermark, no people, no colored light blobs, no rainbow caustics, no giant spheres, no decorative balls, no abstract gradient wallpaper. Nothing should compete with the future center overlay. No page mockup or design composition.
Output intent: high quality large horizontal raster asset for a 1440px wide website scene.

transforms.visualEdits: None. Only proportional resizing and WebP encoding.
